title: ComfyUI Yedp Action Director — 3D Scene Compositor
summary: Advanced 3D viewport and animation system for ComfyUI that enables interactive character posing and scene composition. It generates multi-pass ControlNet data including Depth, Normal, and OpenPose directly from animated 3D assets.
research_notes: Supports up to 16 independent characters and uses Mixamo-standard skeletal naming for auto-rigging.

evolution.summary: Originally a character-posing tool, it has evolved into a full 3D compositor with support for FBX/GLB environment imports, camera tracking, and facial mocap. Latest updates integrated a path-tracing engine for realistic shadows and native support for Gaussian Splatting (.ply/.spz).
